duoVilains.modeDuoMeta: Taking turns, or each on your own phone
duoVilains.relaisDebut: Answer the whole series, then pass the phone.
duoVilains.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
duoVilains.jaugesTitre: What stands out in your answers
duoVilains.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The Halloween night heist: emptying the town's sweet warehouse. Each of you answers the fifteen questions separately, and the result gives each of you your role in the duo, then the famous duo the two of you form.
duoVilains.setupDesc: Enter your first names. The Halloween night heist: emptying the town's sweet warehouse. Each of you answers the fifteen questions separately, and the result gives each of you your role in the duo, then the famous duo the two of you form.
duoVilains.noteFin: A Halloween quiz, just for fun. The characters belong to their creators; the heist of the century stays imaginary.
duoVilains.p_cerveau_d: You plan everything, you see three moves ahead and you hate improvising.
duoVilains.p_chaos_d: You improvise, you laugh, and you blow up the plan as soon as it bores you.
duoVilains.p_muscle_d: You charge in, you carry, you break things, and you protect the other without saying so.
duoVilains.p_charme_d: You negotiate, you seduce, and you get the keys without forcing the lock.
duoVilains.p_ombre_d: Discreet, loyal, you're there without being seen, and you forget nothing.
duoVilains.p_coeur_d: You follow the other out of love, and you're often the one who makes the crazy move.
duoVilains.d_joker_d: Chaos and heart: one blows up the bank, the other applauds in a matching outfit. You're loud, unpredictable, impossible to separate, even when it would be reasonable. Gotham doesn't sleep anymore.
duoVilains.d_joker_a: For Halloween, get the costume in duplicate. And an emergency exit.
duoVilains.d_bonnie_d: Two lovers against the whole world. You hit the road, you never leave each other, and you don't really have a plan, just each other. It's beautiful, it's romantic, and in the books it ends badly.
duoVilains.d_bonnie_a: For Halloween: a hat, a beret, and an old car if you can find one. Be home before the police.
duoVilains.d_rocket_d: Charm, grand speeches, complicated plans... and failure, every time, with panache. You're funny without meaning to be and you always “blast off again”. Everyone loves you, especially your enemies.
duoVilains.d_rocket_a: At Halloween, prepare a motto to recite together. And don't steal anything, you wouldn't manage.
duoVilains.d_vador_d: The brains and the strong arm. One decides from the shadows, the other executes while breathing heavily. It's efficient, it's chilling, and there's always a moment when one of you gets tired of taking orders.
duoVilains.d_vador_a: For Halloween, the throne and the cape. One of you will have to do the breathing all evening.
duoVilains.d_voldemort_d: The master and the devotee. One wants to control everything, the other follows with a loyalty that scares everyone, him included. Powerful, a little sinister, and nobody dares invite you to dinner.
duoVilains.d_voldemort_a: At Halloween, no mask needed: a laugh and a look will do. Leave the wand at home.
duoVilains.d_ivy_d: The duo that left the bad guys to do better. You're independent, loyal to each other, with a soft spot for plants and bad ideas. The people who know you don't worry anymore, they watch.
duoVilains.d_ivy_a: For Halloween, decorate with ivy and glitter. And keep an eye on the hyena.
duoVilains.d_cortex_d: The brains and the brains, well, almost: one prepares to take over the world every night, the other asks the question that makes it all fall apart. And you start again the next day. That's love.
duoVilains.d_cortex_a: For Halloween, prepare a ten-step plan for trick-or-treating. It'll fail at step two, that's normal.
duoVilains.d_wario_d: Muscle and chaos, comedy version. You're loud, not very elegant, a bit jealous of people who succeed, and endearing in the end. Nobody takes you seriously, and that's your best weapon.
duoVilains.d_wario_a: At Halloween, moustaches are mandatory. For both of you.
duoVilains.d_magneto_d: The shadow and the metal. You're discreet, convinced you're right, and able to change faces when needed. A long-standing duo, with ideas, betrayals and comebacks.
duoVilains.d_magneto_a: For Halloween, a helmet and blue paint. You'll look serious, that's the point.
duoVilains.q1: The target: the town's sweet warehouse, on Halloween night. Whose idea was it?
duoVilains.q1a: Mine, with a twelve-step plan and a stopwatch
duoVilains.q1b: Mine, on a whim, when I saw the lorry drive past
duoVilains.q1c: The other one's. Me, I'm here for them, that's all
duoVilains.q1d: Nobody will ever know it was me
duoVilains.q2: The costumes, to blend in with the kids:
duoVilains.q2a: A hand-sewn costume, consistent with the cover story
duoVilains.q2b: A vampire cape open over the muscles; it's also handy for carrying the bags
duoVilains.q2c: The best costume in town: the guards will ask me for a photo
duoVilains.q2d: Two matching costumes, picked by the other one, I don't argue
duoVilains.q3a: I talk to him about his dog for ten minutes, he lends me his keys
duoVilains.q3b: I've followed him for two weeks: I know his cigarette break to the second
duoVilains.q3c: I put him to sleep with a little tap, he'll sleep well
duoVilains.q3d: I scare him half to death with a mask and a scream; he's still running
duoVilains.q4a: Planned for: plan B, second door, forty seconds
duoVilains.q4b: I dance under the flashing lights, it's the best part
duoVilains.q4c: I grab the other one under my arm and leave the way I came in
duoVilains.q4d: I melt into the shadows; you never saw me
duoVilains.q5a: At the wheel, fast and clean, three routes memorised in advance
duoVilains.q5b: In the passenger seat, the bags of sweets already open
duoVilains.q5c: On the other one's lap, it's safer
duoVilains.q5d: In the back, under the tarp; nobody counts to two
duoVilains.q6: A rival offers you both a place in his gang, equal shares.
duoVilains.q6a: I negotiate a third for the two of us, plus the van
duoVilains.q6b: I say no with a single look
duoVilains.q6c: I say yes, then sabotage from the inside
duoVilains.q6d: I ask what the other one thinks before answering
duoVilains.q7: Every pumpkin in the neighbourhood lights up at once. A trap?
duoVilains.q7a: I count: three are missing, someone's been here
duoVilains.q7c: I go first, the others go behind me
duoVilains.q7d: I blow them out and speak politely to whoever's hiding behind them
duoVilains.q8: The loot, back at yours, at three in the morning:
duoVilains.q8a: Sorted by colour and by brand, a spreadsheet on the screen
duoVilains.q8b: Thrown in the air, then a sweet fight
duoVilains.q8c: Half already given to the neighbour's kids, the other half to the other one
duoVilains.q8d: Hidden somewhere even the other one doesn't know about
duoVilains.q9: The police knock on the door. You open:
duoVilains.q9a: In a dressing gown, with a smile, and I offer them coffee
duoVilains.q9b: I'm not here. I was never here
duoVilains.q9c: I confess everything so the other one gets away
duoVilains.q9d: I block the door with my shoulder while the other one slips out
duoVilains.q10: At the police station, in custody:
duoVilains.q10a: Not a word, for forty-eight hours
duoVilains.q10b: I talk a lot, and I make it all up; they lose their minds
duoVilains.q10c: I'd planned for the arrest: the bail is already paid
duoVilains.q10d: I make the officer cry with my story, he drives us home
duoVilains.q11: What you get blamed for most often in the duo:
duoVilains.q11d: Disappearing for three days without a word
duoVilains.q12: That night, after the job, your tradition:
duoVilains.q12a: The debrief: mistakes noted, plan for the next one
duoVilains.q12b: Dancing on the table with the masks on
duoVilains.q12c: Falling asleep on the other one's shoulder in front of a horror film
duoVilains.q12d: Keeping watch at the window, just in case
duoVilains.q14: Your favourite moment of a plan:
duoVilains.q14a: When everything goes exactly as planned
duoVilains.q14d: When the target hands us the keys with a smile
duoVilains.q15: If the duo ever split up:
duoVilains.q15b: I'd find the other one again, out of love or revenge
duoVilains.q15c: I'd put together a new crew in two days
